name: hra-anatomical-structures
title: HRA Anatomical-Structure Term Occurrences
question:
Does the HRA CCF API's ontology-term-occurences endpoint load into a
Step-driven composite, giving an anatomical-structure term occurrence list?

study_card.goal: Fetch HRA anatomical-structure term occurrences via HRAAnatomicalStructuresStep and confirm the composite loads a non-empty, count-sorted term list.
study_card.expected_result: Anatomical-structure terms (mostly Uberon) load as CURIEs sorted by occurrence count descending.
study_card.main_expert_question: Do the highest-occurrence anatomical structures correspond to whole organs (matching reference-organs) or finer sub-structures?

biological_summary:
This histogram counts, across every HRA dataset, how often each
anatomy-ontology (mostly Uberon) term is annotated as the anatomical
structure a sample/observation was taken from. Unlike `hra-reference-organs`
(the fixed ~81-entry whole-organ 3D scaffold) or the 1,730-node ASCT+B-3D
crosswalk (`hra-3d-crosswalk`, every fine-grained anatomical structure
whether or not it has been used), this is usage-weighted: it reflects
which anatomical structures HRA's contributing datasets actually sample
from, not the full catalog of structures that exist.

report.title: HRA Anatomical Structures — 288 distinct terms loaded, top term at 2,762 occurrences
report.objective:
Does the HRA CCF API's ontology-term-occurences endpoint load into a
Step-driven composite, giving an anatomical-structure term occurrence
list?
report.conclusion:
A live run against
`https://apps.humanatlas.io/api/v1/ontology-term-occurences` returned
288 distinct anatomical-structure terms, sorted by occurrence count
descending. The top term (UBERON:0013702) occurs 2,762 times —
matching `hra-cell-types`' top CL-term count exactly, consistent with
both endpoints counting the same underlying per-record annotations from
the same HRA dataset corpus. The next 9 terms (UBERON:0002113,
UBERON:0000948, UBERON:0001004, UBERON:0002048, UBERON:0001987,
UBERON:0000955, UBERON:0002189, UBERON:0002015, UBERON:0004027) range
231-336 occurrences, an order of magnitude below the top term.
report.caveat:
288 terms is well below the ASCT+B-3D crosswalk's 1,730 Uberon-keyed
anatomical-structure nodes (`hra-3d-crosswalk`) — this endpoint only
surfaces structures that appear in HRA's *annotated* datasets, so most
of the crosswalk's fine-grained 3D anatomy has zero recorded usage here
even though it exists as a named 3D structure.
